title: Front and Rear Bumper Mentions
summary: This topic combines bumper appearance comments, delivery-condition damage reports, and procedural descriptions of the kick-to-open sensor under the rear bumper, with most fragments lacking clear evaluative sentiment.

positive.summary: The only positive review praises the front bumper’s smooth design lines.

negative.summary: The only negative review reports front bumper damage present at purchase and a dealer commitment to repair it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly describe rear-bumper kick gesture instructions or note bumper scratches, loose trim, paint chipping, and dirt buildup without a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic mixes unrelated subjects including bumper styling, purchase-condition damage, surface wear, loose trim, dirt accumulation, and kick-sensor usage instructions.
Samples are stratified and not representative of all reviews for this topic.
